instruction: Activate voice dictation mode so you can create and edit the document using only voice commands without typing.

metadata.explanation: LibreOffice Writer does not have built-in voice dictation or speech-to-text capabilities. While users can use external voice recognition software, there is no native voice control feature within LibreOffice.
